title: Founder Live Runtime Admission Readiness
objective: Move approved dispatch readiness toward governed runtime admission readiness while keeping actual runtime admission and execution blocked until explicitly allowed.
safetyRules: Do not enable runtime admission, execution unlock, worker/tool execution, provider/model calls, agent dispatch, project mutation, hosted DB mutation, raw SQL, deploy, release, export, package, network calls, or provider spend in P115.1.
Do not expose DemoApp in full Command Center.
Do not show raw private project IDs, runtime admission record keys, raw DB table names, raw JSON, raw logs, or raw policy dumps in primary UX.
Do not invent fake working actions or live run buttons.

subphases.dataShape: No runtime data shape is added. P115.1 records the implementation-grade contract for future runtime admission readiness work only.
